'''2000 Coruscant Civil War''' was a constructed Star Wars CCG tournament held in late 2000. Brian Terwilliger went 3–1 there with a Light Hidden Base list designed by [[Aaron Kingery]], losing only to farimar.<ref name="dt-12061">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/12061 Twigg's Our Most Desperate Hour Mains and Smack], DeckTech (Brian "twigg" Terwilliger, 28 November 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/12061/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/12061/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018091155/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/12061/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 4 November 2000<ref name="tr-d1422" />
* '''Site:''' Altered States, Syracuse, New York<ref name="tr-d1422" />
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]] (the reports' decks use its objectives)<ref name="tr-d1417" />
* '''Players:''' 45<ref name="tr-d1422" />
* '''Winner:''' [[Brian Terwilliger]]<ref name="tr-d1422" />

== Discrepancies ==

Where a source disagrees with the record on this page, the page keeps the record and notes the difference here.

* The hub (from Terwilliger's later DeckTech deck post) gives his finish as 3–1; that is his Light deck's record. His report gives 7–1 overall (14 (+79)) and 1st place.<ref name="tr-d1417" />
